entities.summary: Abū Bakr Muḥammad ibn ʿAmmār ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn ʿAmmār al-Quḍā'ī, known as Ibn Ammar, in Spanish sources found as Abenámar, was an Arab poet from Silves.
